instruction.text: Lies den folgenden Text über das Stadtleben und beantworte anschließend die Fragen.

atoms.text:
City Life can be both exciting and exhausting.

One downside is the lack of nature since most big cities have limited green areas, and always being surrounded by buildings can definitely be overwhelming. In addition, pollution and noise can be a huge problem due to all the traffic and the many people living there. Furthermore, many cities have a higher crime rate, which makes daily life more dangerous.
In contrast, getting around in cities is much easier since public transportation is well developed. There are also many cultural activities, such as museums or cinemas, which make life in a city very exciting. Lastly, cities are characterized not only by an enormous diversity of people, but also by almost unlimited opportunities of networking.

To conclude, I can say that there are many advantages and disadvantages and how one perceives city life depends on personal preferences.
